# FindMyPart

Product key: findmypart
Canonical product: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/products/findmypart
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/findmypart/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/findmypart/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- where can I find this discontinued part
- I have a part number but cannot find it anywhere
- identify this machine part from a photo or markings
- find a replacement for an obsolete part
- find a salvage or donor part
- find a fabrication path when the original part is unavailable
- find a discontinued tractor part
- find an obsolete automotive or machine part
- identify a hard-to-source part from markings measurements photos or equipment clues
- find replacement donor salvage or fabrication paths when normal sourcing fails

## Authority

public discovery and human-confirmed paid sourcing hunts

## Boundaries

- unknowns may remain unknown
- compatibility is not guaranteed
- checkout creation is not payment proof
- private vendor, analytics, session, command-center, and sales data are not public

## Universal Evercraft routing

https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
